ServiceAutomacoes.title: Automation
ServiceAutomacoes.lead: Repetitive tasks happening on their own, so the team can spend time on what actually needs attention.

sections.title: What's included
sections.body: We automate contact with customers and partners across channels like WhatsApp, Instagram and email, plus internal routines that today depend on someone copying information from one system to another.

sections.title: When it makes sense
sections.body: When a process always follows the same pattern, but still depends on someone remembering to do it — confirm an order, update a spreadsheet, send a message.

ServiceAutomacoes.ctaTitle: Is there a task that repeats every single day?
ServiceAutomacoes.ctaBody: Tell us how it works today — we'll assess whether it can be automated and how.
